description: Ministry of City Planing & Water Supply - Order made to approve the acquisition of the immovable properly in Siyambalawa, D/S/D Ruwanwella, Kegalle District for the constructions of the Ruwanwella Water Supply Scheme
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land acquisition for a public infrastructure project. It specifically approves the acquisition of an immovable property (land) for the construction of an access road to a water storage tank. The document includes detailed land description, boundaries, extent (10.3 perches), location details, and the name/address of the land claimant. While it involves a government minister's approval, the core subject matter is land acquisition and property rights, making it a Land Gazette (Type 4) rather than a government personnel or structural matter.
